items.title: Trusted by people of the Greater Toronto Area

c: Removing wall units requires more than just strength; it demands expertise. These bulky, often built-in structures can damage walls, floors, and surrounding spaces if not handled carefully. Our specialized service caters to all types, from compact shelving units to expansive, floor-to-ceiling built-ins. Whether it’s carefully detaching anchored units without harming drywall, maneuvering large pieces through tight spaces, or safely hauling heavy materials downstairs, we manage every step. Our full-service solution includes secure disassembly, protective removal, and responsible disposal or donation, all while you relax and supervise.

We start with a free, transparent quote, so you know exactly what to expect, no hidden fees. Serving your area, we prioritize fast, affordable, and sustainable removal, helping you reclaim your space without the hassle.

items.q: Do you remove all types of wall units?
a: Yes, we remove all types, including freestanding, built-in, and custom wall units.

items.q: Can you disassemble my wall unit before taking it?
a: Absolutely! Our team can safely disassemble your wall unit before removal.

items.q: How much does wall unit removal cost?
a: Costs vary based on size, complexity, and location. Contact us for a free quote. We also help calculate your load-bearing wall removal cost in Toronto before work begins.

items.q: What areas do you serve for wall unit removal?
a: We serve Toronto and the surrounding areas. Call us to confirm your location.

items.q: Do you donate or recycle wall units?
a: Yes, we prioritize donating and recycling whenever possible to reduce waste.

items.q: Will you remove built-in or custom wall units?
a: Yes, we specialize in removing built-in and custom-designed wall units.
Same-day pickups are available based on scheduling. Contact us for availability.

items.q: Do I need to clear out my wall unit before removal?
a: Yes, please empty the unit before removal to ensure a smooth process.
